title: Kelowna Wine Tour by E-Bike with Tastings, Lunch & Local Guide
includes: All biking essentials (helmet, lock, first aid, bike bag)
Tour Guide / Concierge for the duration of the tour.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age to ride an e-bike is 16 years
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Kelowna with knowledgeable local guide on a journey through the flavours and landscapes of the Okanagan Valley. Visit three venues for tastings of wines and meads, while your guide leads the scenic route, shares regional stories and provides concierge service at each stop.

Enjoy a delicious farm-to-table lunch at Meadow Vista Honey Wines, choosing from freshly prepared main courses in its countryside setting.

During this four- to five-hour experience, ride past scenic lakes, orchards and rolling countryside while discovering the agricultural traditions and exceptional produce that have earned Kelowna recognition as Canada’s first UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy.

Our premium e-bikes make the journey comfortable and effortless, with adjustable pedal assistance and a throttle option for an extra boost on the hills. Your helmet, bike bag, lock and phone mount are included, allowing you to relax and fully enjoy the spectacular scenery, hospitality and flavours of the Okanagan.
